messages.author: 1868e89fb89fe005
messages.subject: Reactively render model summary?
parts:
I'm new to Shiny, but really impressed.

After modeling some data, I'd like to include the summary that R would print interactively, but as reactive text.  For example, I classified some data with a SVM and then got a confusion matrix.

In an interactive R session, if I ask for

confusionMatrix(testset[,5],svm.pred)

I get

Confusion Matrix and Statistics

          Reference
Prediction loss win
      loss  229  21
      win    23  60
                                         
               Accuracy : 0.8679    

etc.
 
But if I wrap it in renderPrint/textOutput, I get
 
Confusion Matrix and Statistics Reference Prediction loss win loss 354 392 win 3 251 Accuracy : 0.605 95% CI : (0.5739, 0.6355) No Information Rate : 0.643 P-Value [Acc > NIR] : 0.9942 Kappa : 0.3075 Mcnemar's Test P-Value : <2e-16 Sensitivity : 0.9916 Specificity : 0.3904 Pos Pred Value : 0.4745 Neg Pred Value : 0.9882 Prevalence : 0.3570 Detection Rate : 0.3540 Detection Prevalence : 0.7460 Balanced Accuracy : 0.6910 'Positive' Class : loss
Is it possible to retain the formatting?
 
thanks,
Mark

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Reactively render model summary?
parts:
In ui.R, use verbatimTextOutput('foo'); in server.R, use output$foo <-
renderPrint().

Regards,
Yihui
